name: Instagram Blocks for WordPress – Embed Instagram Posts, Feed & Images Plugin
author: Krasen Slavov

sections.description:
Embed Instagram posts and images instantly with Instagram Blocks – the simple WordPress Instagram plugin that adds Instagram content directly in the Gutenberg Block Editor.

Stop using complicated Instagram feed plugins with API headaches. Instagram Blocks lets you embed Instagram posts directly in WordPress using simple public URLs. Just paste an Instagram URL into the Gutenberg block, customize the display, and publish – your Instagram content appears beautifully embedded on your WordPress site.

Whether you’re showcasing Instagram photos, building an Instagram feed, or adding social proof, Instagram Blocks makes WordPress Instagram integration simple and visual.

Why Choose Instagram Blocks?

  • WordPress Instagram Embed – Add Instagram posts to Block Editor instantly
  • Instagram Feed – Display Instagram images in WordPress visually
  • Simple Setup – Embed Instagram with public URLs, no API required
  • Gutenberg Instagram – Native WordPress Block Editor integration
  • Instagram Widget – Add Instagram blocks anywhere in WordPress
  • Visual Preview – See Instagram embeds before publishing

How WordPress Instagram Embed Works

  1. Install and activate Instagram Blocks on your WordPress site
  2. Edit any post or page in the WordPress Block Editor
  3. Click the Instagram Blocks icon in the block inserter
  4. Paste a public Instagram post URL
  5. Customize display with Block Editor controls
  6. Publish your WordPress page with embedded Instagram

Zero configuration required – works immediately with public Instagram posts using Instagram’s official embed.

Perfect For

  • Bloggers embedding Instagram photos in WordPress posts
  • Businesses displaying Instagram feed on WordPress websites
  • Photographers showcasing Instagram portfolio in WordPress
  • Social Media Managers adding Instagram content to WordPress
  • Marketing Teams creating Instagram widget sections
  • E-commerce Stores showing Instagram product photos

WordPress Instagram Features

Embed Instagram Posts
Add Instagram posts to WordPress using simple public URLs. Paste any Instagram URL into the Instagram block and it embeds automatically using Instagram’s official embed script. No API keys, no authentication – just instant WordPress Instagram integration.

Instagram Feed for WordPress
Create visual Instagram feeds in WordPress by adding multiple Instagram blocks. Display Instagram images in grids, galleries, or individual posts. Perfect for WordPress Instagram feed sections showcasing your latest Instagram content.

Instagram Widget Blocks
Native WordPress Gutenberg blocks for Instagram embeds. Add Instagram anywhere in your WordPress layout using Block Editor. Customize width, alignment, and display settings for each Instagram widget on your WordPress site.

Visual Instagram Preview
Preview Instagram embeds in WordPress Block Editor before publishing. See exactly how Instagram posts will appear on your WordPress site. Test different Instagram block layouts and customize display in real-time.

Instagram Image Display
Embed Instagram images beautifully in WordPress posts and pages. Instagram photos display with proper aspect ratios and responsive design. Instagram embeds adapt to WordPress theme widths automatically.

Block Editor Instagram Controls
Customize Instagram embeds with native WordPress Block Editor controls. Adjust Instagram block width, height, alignment, and spacing. All Instagram customization happens visually in Gutenberg without code.

Usage

Once the WordPress Instagram plugin is installed and activated:

  1. Edit any post or page in WordPress Block Editor (Gutenberg)
  2. Click the + button to add a new block
  3. Search for Instagram Blocks and select the block
  4. Paste a public Instagram post URL (e.g., https://www.instagram.com/p/CQJVP9-pvLD/)
  5. Customize display using Block Editor controls
  6. Preview your WordPress Instagram embed
  7. Publish to display Instagram on your WordPress site

Here are the steps to use Instagram Blocks:

  1. Add Block – Insert Instagram Blocks in WordPress Gutenberg
  2. Paste URL – Enter public Instagram post URL
  3. Customize – Adjust width, height, alignment in Block Editor
  4. Preview – See Instagram embed in WordPress preview mode
  5. Publish – Instagram content now displays on WordPress site

Note: Video embeds and advanced Instagram feed features available in Pro version.

WordPress Instagram Settings

Embedding Instagram Posts:
1. Open WordPress post in Block Editor
2. Click + to add Instagram Blocks
3. Paste Instagram URL (must be public post)
4. Instagram embed appears automatically
5. Use Block Editor sidebar to customize display
6. Adjust width and alignment for WordPress layout
7. Preview and publish Instagram on WordPress

Creating Instagram Feed:
1. Add multiple Instagram Blocks to WordPress page
2. Paste different Instagram URLs for each block
3. Arrange Instagram blocks in WordPress layout
4. Create grid or gallery of Instagram images
5. Customize each Instagram widget individually
6. Build complete Instagram feed section in WordPress

Instagram Block Customization:
1. Select Instagram block in WordPress editor
2. Open Block Editor sidebar controls
3. Adjust Instagram widget width and height
4. Set alignment (left, center, right, wide, full)
5. Configure spacing and margins
6. Use style presets for consistent Instagram display

Supported Instagram Content:
– Public Instagram posts
– Instagram images (photos)
– Instagram carousels (single image shown)

Features & Limitations

The Instagram Blocks WordPress Instagram plugin allows you to:

  • Embed Instagram posts in WordPress Block Editor instantly
  • Add Instagram feed to WordPress pages and posts
  • Display Instagram images on WordPress site visually
  • Create Instagram widget sections in Gutenberg
  • Use public Instagram URLs without API authentication
  • Customize Instagram block display with WordPress controls
  • Preview Instagram embeds before publishing in WordPress
  • Add unlimited Instagram posts to WordPress content
  • Adjust Instagram widget width, height, and alignment
  • Build Instagram galleries with multiple blocks
  • Use Instagram official embed script for proper display
  • Access Instagram blocks in WordPress Gutenberg inserter

WordPress Instagram Components

Instagram Embed Block
Native WordPress Gutenberg block for embedding Instagram posts. Add Instagram content directly in Block Editor with simple URL input. Instagram blocks integrate seamlessly with WordPress layout and theme styling.

Instagram Feed Display
Create visual Instagram feeds by combining multiple Instagram blocks in WordPress. Display Instagram images in custom layouts, grids, or galleries. Perfect for WordPress Instagram feed sections and Instagram widget areas.

Block Editor Controls
Full WordPress Gutenberg controls for Instagram customization. Adjust Instagram block dimensions, alignment, spacing directly in Block Editor. All Instagram display settings accessible in WordPress sidebar panel.

Style Presets
Save Instagram block configurations as reusable presets. Apply consistent Instagram styling across WordPress site. Create default Instagram widget styles for brand consistency.

Instagram Official Embed
Uses Instagram’s official embed.js script for proper Instagram post rendering. Instagram embeds display with authentic Instagram branding and functionality. Clicking Instagram embeds opens posts on Instagram.

Responsive Instagram Widget
Instagram blocks automatically adapt to WordPress theme widths. Instagram embeds display properly on mobile, tablet, and desktop. Responsive Instagram images scale to fit WordPress containers.

Known Limitations

Free version features:

  • Content Types – Instagram images only (Videos in Pro)
  • Authentication – Public URLs only, no Instagram API (API in Pro)
  • Customization – Basic controls (Advanced customization in Pro)
  • Video Support – Not available (Instagram videos in Pro)
  • Gallery Blocks – Single images only (Carousel display in Pro)
  • Caption Controls – Limited (Full caption editing in Pro)
  • Heading Options – Basic (Advanced heading styles in Pro)
  • Priority Support – Community support only (Priority support in Pro)

Detailed Documentation

Find step-by-step setup guides, video tutorials, WordPress Instagram examples, and embed tips on the Instagram Blocks Documentation page.

Instagram Blocks Pro

If you’re using the free WordPress Instagram plugin from WordPress.org and want Pro features, you can purchase the premium version on the Instagram Blocks Pro website.

Here are some features included in the Pro version:

  • Instagram Video Embeds – Embed Instagram videos in WordPress posts
  • Instagram Gallery Blocks – Display Instagram carousels with multiple images
  • Instagram API Integration – Secure Instagram authentication for advanced features
  • Advanced Instagram Feed – Auto-updating Instagram feeds for WordPress
  • Custom Instagram Widget – Enhanced Instagram block controls and styling
  • Instagram Caption Editor – Customize captions for embedded Instagram posts
  • Instagram Heading Controls – Add custom headings to Instagram blocks
  • Block Edit Mode – Advanced Instagram embed editing in WordPress
  • Instagram Feed Layouts – Grid, masonry, and slider Instagram displays
  • Auto-Refresh Feed – Keep Instagram content updated automatically
  • Hashtag Feed – Display Instagram posts by hashtag in WordPress
  • Priority Support – Fast expert help for WordPress Instagram integration
  • Regular Updates – Early access to new Instagram block features

External Services

This plugin integrates with Instagram to embed posts directly into WordPress content blocks.

It uses Instagram’s official JavaScript embed script, which is loaded from https://www.instagram.com/embed.js.

What data is sent and when:

  • When a page containing Instagram embed block is viewed, the plugin loads Instagram’s embed script to render the post
  • This may send user-related information such as IP address, browser details, and referrer headers to Instagram’s servers
  • No personal data is collected or stored by this plugin itself

Why:

The script is required to render Instagram posts correctly within WordPress blocks.

External service:

  • Service: Instagram (provided by Meta Platforms, Inc.)
  • Terms of Use: https://help.instagram.com/581066165581870
  • Privacy Policy: https://privacycenter.instagram.com/policy
sections.installation:
Installing the WordPress Instagram plugin is straightforward. Contact support if you encounter any issues.

Requirements:
– WordPress 5.0 or higher
– PHP 7.2 or higher
– Gutenberg Block Editor
– Public Instagram posts to embed

Installation from WordPress

  1. Go to Plugins > Add New
  2. Search for Instagram Blocks
  3. Click Install Now then Activate
  4. Edit any post to access Instagram Blocks

Manual Installation

  1. Download the WordPress Instagram plugin ZIP file
  2. Upload the block-editor-social-embeds folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  3. Go to Plugins in WordPress admin
  4. Activate Instagram Blocks
  5. Edit any post to access Instagram blocks

After Activation

The plugin works immediately! Add Instagram Blocks to any WordPress post or page:

  1. Edit any page or post in WordPress Block Editor
  2. Click + to add a new block
  3. Search for Instagram Blocks in block inserter
  4. Select Instagram Blocks (green icon)
  5. Paste a public Instagram post URL
  6. Customize with Block Editor controls
  7. Preview your Instagram embed
  8. Publish to display Instagram on WordPress

Quick Start:
1. Edit WordPress post
2. Add Instagram Blocks block
3. Paste Instagram URL
4. Customize and publish
5. Instagram displays on your site!
sections.faq:
Visit the Support Forum to share your questions or requests.

We usually respond to tickets within a few business days.

Feature requests are added to our wish list and considered for future updates.

How do I embed Instagram posts in WordPress?

Add an Instagram Blocks block to any WordPress post, paste a public Instagram URL (like https://www.instagram.com/p/XXXXXX/), and the Instagram post embeds automatically. Customize display with WordPress Block Editor controls.

What’s the best WordPress Instagram plugin?

Instagram Blocks provides simple, reliable Instagram embedding for WordPress. Native Gutenberg integration, no API required, instant preview, and official Instagram embed script make it ideal for adding Instagram to WordPress sites.

How to add Instagram feed to WordPress?

Add multiple Instagram Blocks to a WordPress page, paste different Instagram URLs for each block, and arrange them in your desired layout. This creates an Instagram feed display using WordPress Block Editor.

Can I embed Instagram without API?

Yes, Instagram Blocks uses public Instagram URLs and Instagram’s official embed script – no API keys or authentication required. Just paste public Instagram post URLs into WordPress blocks.

Does this work with Gutenberg Block Editor?

Yes, Instagram Blocks is designed specifically for WordPress Gutenberg. Instagram blocks appear in the block inserter and integrate natively with WordPress Block Editor controls.

Can I embed Instagram videos?

Instagram video embeds are available in Instagram Blocks Pro. The free version supports Instagram image posts only.

How to create Instagram widget in WordPress?

Add an Instagram Blocks block to any WordPress page or post. The Instagram block acts as an Instagram widget that you can customize and place anywhere in your WordPress layout using Block Editor.

Does this display Instagram feed automatically?

The free version requires manual Instagram URL input. Pro version includes auto-updating Instagram feeds that pull latest posts automatically from Instagram accounts.

Can I customize Instagram embeds in WordPress?

Yes, use WordPress Block Editor controls to customize Instagram block width, height, alignment, and spacing. Style presets let you save Instagram display configurations for reuse across WordPress site.

Will this slow down my WordPress site?

No, Instagram Blocks loads Instagram’s official embed script efficiently. Instagram embeds only load on pages where you’ve added Instagram blocks, ensuring minimal WordPress performance impact.

How many Instagram posts can I embed?

Unlimited! Add as many Instagram Blocks as needed to your WordPress content. Create full Instagram feed pages with dozens of Instagram embeds or add individual Instagram posts throughout WordPress site.

Do I need an Instagram account?

No, you don’t need an Instagram account to embed public Instagram posts in WordPress. However, the Instagram posts you embed must be from public Instagram accounts.

Does this work with Instagram private accounts?

No, Instagram Blocks can only embed posts from public Instagram accounts. Private Instagram account posts cannot be embedded using public URLs on WordPress sites.

Can I embed Instagram stories in WordPress?

Instagram Stories are not supported for embedding. Instagram Blocks embeds permanent Instagram posts only. Stories expire and cannot be embedded with Instagram’s official embed script.

Is this Instagram plugin GDPR compliant?

Instagram Blocks uses Instagram’s official embed.js which may load cookies. Inform visitors about Instagram embeds on your WordPress site and ensure compliance with local privacy laws.

Does Instagram Blocks use Instagram API?

The free version doesn’t require Instagram API – it uses public URLs and Instagram’s embed script. Pro version includes optional Instagram API integration for advanced features.
